# Cryptococcus(Archived)

**Authors:** Pradeep Kumar Mada, Radia T. Jamil, Mohammed U. Alam

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

Cryptococcus is an invasive fungus that causes cryptococcosis, an infection commonly associated with immunosuppressed individuals, while being rare in healthy individuals. The 2 species of Cryptococcus that are commonly associated with infections in humans are Cryptococcus neoformans and Cryptococcus gatti. The organism is widely prevalent in certain regions of the world. However, the most common forms of exposure include a history of exposure to soil and bird droppings.
